summary: Las Vegas Sands Corp. filed Form 8-K disclosing entry into an underwriting agreement to issue $1 billion aggregate principal amount of senior notes: $500 million of 5.300% notes due 2031 at 99.787% of par and $500 million of 5.650% notes due 2033 at 99.873% of par. The offering is a routine debt capital markets transaction with Barclays, BofA Securities, Goldman Sachs, and SMBC Nikko as underwriters, expected to close on May 13, 2026. No special-situation elements exist; this is an ordinary financing event without strategic implications.
